title: Composable CXL Memory as a Kubernetes-Native Shared Memory for LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2609.10790v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) driver that makes composable CXL memory a schedulable cluster resource, and evaluate the resulting shared-memory tier for cross-node KV-cache reuse in LLM serving. The driver composes CXL regions on demand, materializes them as DAX devices on each participating host, and injects them into pods under a single Container Device Interface (CDI) name so that pods on different nodes access the same physical region. A shared-memory connector for vLLM/llm-d uses that region as a KV-cache tier with a slot directory embedded inside the shared medium, which eliminates the need for an external metadata service. On a two-node cluster with a 512\,GiB CXL appliance and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, cross-node prefix reuse reduces TTFT by 5.5$\times$--36.6$\times$ at an external hit rate of 95.4--99.5\,\%, while node-local tiers (GPU prefix caching, CPU-DRAM offload) fall back to full recompute. translated_title: 可组合CXL内存作为面向大语言模型服务的Kubernetes原生共享内存
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种Kubernetes动态资源分配（DRA）驱动程序，使可组合的CXL内存成为可调度的集群资源，并评估了由此产生的共享内存层在大语言模型服务中实现跨节点KV缓存重用的效果。该驱动程序按需组合CXL内存区域，将其作为DAX设备在每台参与的主机上实例化，并通过单一的容器设备接口（CDI）名称将其注入到Pod中，使得不同节点上的Pod可以访问同一物理区域。面向vLLM/llm-d的共享内存连接器将该区域用作KV缓存层，并在共享介质内部嵌入槽位目录，从而无需外部元数据服务。在一个配备512 GiB CXL设备的双节点集群上，使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型的实验表明，跨节点前缀重用在95.4%–99.5%的外部命中率下将首Token生成时间（TTFT）降低了5.5倍至36.6倍，而节点本地缓存层（GPU前缀缓存、CPU-DRAM卸载）则只能回退到完全重新计算。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个Kubernetes DRA驱动程序，将可组合CXL内存转化为可调度的集群共享内存资源，用于大语言模型服务中跨节点KV缓存重用，无需外部元数据服务即可将首Token延迟降低最高36.6倍。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a Kubernetes DRA driver that makes composable CXL memory a schedulable cluster shared-memory resource for cross-node KV-cache reuse in LLM serving, eliminating external metadata services and reducing TTFT by up to 36.6×.
